title: Tech Note: 4D for OCI: Error Handling
author: Josh Fletcher, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note documents error handling in the 4D for OCI plug-in, a native Oracle connectivity add-on that let 4D applications act as direct Oracle clients via the Oracle Call Interface, contrasting manual return-code checking against an ON ERR CALL-style automatic error handler. The 4D for OCI plug-in itself has since been discontinued as 4D moved database connectivity toward its built-in SQL engine (introduced in 4D v11 SQL, 2007) and standard ODBC-based external table/database access, so this specific plug-in API is now obsolete. The general error-handling pattern it teaches (checking return codes vs. installing a centralized error-catching method) mirrors 4D's own ON ERR CALL mechanism, which remains a valid and current concept.
related_updates: The 4D for OCI plug-in has been discontinued; direct Oracle connectivity is no longer offered as this dedicated plug-in
4D's native SQL engine (from 4D v11 SQL onward) and ODBC-based external database connections are the modern paths for connecting 4D to external databases including Oracle
